items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: regular man in San Francisco at that time?

ctx.x: but then why? At that time, we didn't have a weight to come down, couldn't get weight, and Dink knew it all. Who was your
regular man in San Francisco at that time?

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: Wade had been with you all that time?

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, I don't know what happened to Wade, you see.
Wade had been with you all that time?
Yeah. But we got Dink. Wills and Spice had to go Dink. I don't know. Something. I don't know. We got a hold of him. I don't know.
